findings.text: the section computed table prints allowances without the pace multiple (2.65 percent, 3.21 percent, 6.94 percent) while the landed module folds the multiple in (2.917, 3.514, 7.639 percent at the documented pair, measured by a direct call at 1411341f), and the landing record at :125 does not reconcile the two, so the section carries two allowances for the same states.

the parametrized assertion that every allowance carries the multiple pins the returned field to the configured multiple and passes under a mutation that drops the factor from the derivation, so alone it cannot show that the value was produced by it; the arithmetic is covered at :97, :160 and :230 and the node discloses the limit, so this is a coverage caveat rather than a behaviour defect.

the fence asks each tunable to be asserted a flight key; the tests assert each as a key of a plain config mapping, and the flight schema rejects unknown budget keys one layer before this module reads them, so the clause is asserted in appearance only, and the node records it as its unmet half.

item_verdicts.goal: read the goal line and plan section 2; reckon/crew/pace.py:180 derives remaining_budget * multiple / windows per group with the provider ceiling applied last at :188, so the landed change does what the node goal states.

item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff 8e57bdaa09f4aadf45460ffbb0605b99fda71d3a..1411341f touches exactly the four declared paths, all additions, and the worktree is clean.
